runtimeOverlay: scripts/prepare-izlauncher.cjs creates a separate Mac IZlauncher runtime with File Exchange, pinned BlitBun and VacooTube adaptations, an offline shader compiler and a precompiled shell from this pinned snapshot; the IZMYSH host profile launches its bundled server source for native-session verification.
scope: IZlauncher, File Exchange 1.1.1, BlitBun and VacooTube on an existing verified held RPC session, including kurumuz and BermTheSequel demo sessions; compatible custom IZlauncher modules may be added to the private runtime. The optional IZMYSH host profile uses NS2I and port 39395 for native-session verification, then closes RPC. IZPSlauncher source is bundled but not started by mac2jb; no platform bootstrap, desktop panel or HID agent is included.
